text:
Challenge the **onboarding-load estimate: 4 experienced developer-hours per week**.

- It is an Olumi estimate, not your evidence, and it directly offsets delivery capacity in the six-month window.
- More importantly, a single figure may conceal the key difference: onboarding a tech lead, versus two developers, is likely to require different intensity and duration.
- If experienced capacity is tight, this assumption could outweigh the added hiring capacity; if it is low, it may barely matter.
